claims: The Charlotte Hornets' season ended following a loss in the NBA Play-In Tournament.
LaMelo Ball was fined $35,000 for a play in the NBA Play-In Tournament.
LaMelo Ball was not suspended for the final games.
LaMelo Ball played 25 minutes in a 121-90 loss to the Magic on April 17, 2026.
The Charlotte Hornets were eliminated from contention.
